---
title: "Why are the wings swept forwards?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 100.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 60.0     # s for any one solve

res = optimize_glider_with_fuse(verbose=False)
sol = res['sol']
glider = make_glider_with_fuse(
    sol.value(res['c_root']), 
    sol.value(res['taper']), 
    sol.value(res['cg_x'])
)
wing = glider.wings[0]

le_sweep = wing.mean_sweep_angle(0)
c4_sweep = wing.mean_sweep_angle(0.25)
te_sweep = wing.mean_sweep_angle(1.0)
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{-c4_sweep:.1f}°"`]{.hero-value}
[quarter-chord forward sweep]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** The leading edge is defined as completely straight (`{python} f"{le_sweep:.0f}°"` sweep). The optimizer chose a taper ratio of roughly `{python} f"{sol.value(res['taper']):.2f}"` to reduce induced drag. Because the chord shrinks while the leading edge stays fixed, the quarter-chord line—which defines aerodynamic sweep—is pulled forward at the tips, creating `{python} f"{-c4_sweep:.1f}°"` of forward sweep. The trailing edge is swept forward even more (`{python} f"{-te_sweep:.1f}°"`).

```{python}
#| label: fig-sweep
#| fig-cap: "Top-down view of the wing planform, showing the straight leading edge and the resulting forward sweep of the quarter-chord and trailing edge lines."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
c_root_val = sol.value(res['c_root']) * 1000
taper_val = sol.value(res['taper'])
c_tip_val = c_root_val * taper_val
b_half = 150 # mm

# Right wing half
ax.plot([0, b_half], [0, 0], 'k-', label="Leading edge (0°)")
ax.plot([0, b_half], [-c_root_val, -c_tip_val], 'k-', label="Trailing edge")
ax.plot([0, b_half], [-c_root_val * 0.25, -c_tip_val * 0.25], 'r--', label="Quarter-chord")
ax.plot([0, 0], [0, -c_root_val], 'k-')
ax.plot([b_half, b_half], [0, -c_tip_val], 'k-')

# Left wing half
ax.plot([0, -b_half], [0, 0], 'k-')
ax.plot([0, -b_half], [-c_root_val, -c_tip_val], 'k-')
ax.plot([0, -b_half], [-c_root_val * 0.25, -c_tip_val * 0.25], 'r--')
ax.plot([-b_half, -b_half], [0, -c_tip_val], 'k-')

ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.set_xlabel("Spanwise position (mm)")
ax.set_ylabel("Chordwise position (mm) [Negative aft]")
ax.legend(loc='lower center')
```
